title: OfflineCacheManifest
description: Manifest for the field-deployable offline corpus cache (FR-RAG-LS-02). Built by `apps/ingest-runner/src/ama_ingest/offline_bundle.py`; consumed by `apps/agents/common/offline_cache.py`. Bounded ≤ 500 MB per device. TTL 14 days; stale-warning at day 11 (R-07). Dual-signed (cosign keyless + age detached) per spec 032 FR-AI09 + R-07 fail-closed.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump on breaking change; consumer agents pin major version.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC build time. Used to compute TTL expiry and stale-warning crossover.

corpus_build_sha.description: Pins the bundle to a specific corpus build for replay parity with online AuditRecord entries.

ttl_days.description: Hard expiry. After day 14 the agent refuses to use the cache and forces a re-sync (R-07; FR-RAG-LS-02).

stale_warning_days.description: UI 'cache stale' badge surfaces from day 11 (R-07). Allows 3-day re-sync window before hard expiry.

embedding_model_id.description: MUST equal every entry's underlying chunk embedding_model_id. Bundle is single-model — a model flip triggers a full bundle rebuild (consistent with R-05 single-model invariant).

entries.description: Lazy-load index. Each entry references a chunk_id whose text + embedding live in the sibling .bin file (chunk_id-keyed offset table). Selection per FR-RAG-LS-02 + Field Coordinator persona memo: AIDR + national + each jurisdiction's most-cited handbooks (hazard thresholds, AIIMS span-of-control, evacuation centre setup, sector boundaries).

size_bytes_total.description: Hard cap 500 × 1024 × 1024 = 524288000 bytes. Build fails if exceeded; persona-memo prioritisation must shed lower-priority entries.

signatures.description: Dual-signed envelope. BOTH signatures MUST be present and valid; verification fails closed (R-07).

cosign_keyless.description: Sigstore + GitHub OIDC keyless signature (spec 032 FR-AI09). Verified online; supplies build-supply-chain provenance.

age_detached.description: age-encrypted detached signature using the tenant's offline public-key set. Allows Field Coordinators to verify integrity in degraded-connectivity mode without OIDC reachability.

age_recipients.description: List of age recipient public keys the bundle was signed for; informational.
